subject: Media Literacy
title: Native Digital Ads
description: Learn Native Digital Ads in one minute.

hook.text: You read an article about productivity tips. It was actually an ad for a note-taking app. You couldn't tell.

buildup.text: Native digital ads are designed to blend seamlessly with the platform's regular content.

discovery.text: On social feeds, native ads look like regular posts. In search results, they look like organic listings.

twist.text: Research shows that 70% of people can't distinguish native ads from editorial content.

climax.text: The best native ad is one you consume without ever realizing it was paid advertising.

punchline.text: The best ad is the one you don't recognize as an ad.

quiz.question: What makes native digital ads problematic?
options: Most people can't distinguish them from regular content
